Tap payment-provider webhook — authenticated by an HMAC-SHA256 'hashstring' header (constant-time compare, fail-closed with no dev bypass), then the charge is re-fetched from Tap with our own key before any state change; not JWT.

Tap clinic-onboarding (Connect) callback — Tap documents no signature, so the unguessable per-session token in the URL (sha256-hashed at rest, constant 200 for any token) is the only authenticator, and the body is only ever recorded as an advisory, allow-listed claim for platform-admin review: it can never approve a clinic or choose where money goes. Throttled; never logs the body; not JWT.

Patient pay page: describes a pay link (clinic, services, time, amount, state — no patient identity). Authorised by the unguessable link token; a bad token is a uniform 404; per-IP throttled; not JWT (the payer has no account).

Patient pay page: starts or resumes the payment behind a pay link. Authorised by the link token and accepts NO body — price, clinic and merchant are derived server-side; per-IP throttled (tightest of the three); not JWT (the payer has no account).

Patient return page: takes a gateway charge id and reports what the gateway says about a booking payment. Cannot settle anything the gateway did not capture (amount/currency re-verified); an unknown charge is a uniform 404; per-IP throttled; the signed webhook stays the authority; not JWT.

Patient action link: describes the appointment behind a cancel/reschedule link (clinic, branch, services, doctor name, time, status, per-action allowed flags, clinic contact — no patient identity or financial detail). Authorised by the 256-bit random single-use link token (only its sha256 digest is stored; PatientActionLinkService.resolve — expires at min(7d, appointment start), consumed on use); every unknown/expired/consumed token is the same uniform 404. Read-only, no side effect. Per-IP @Throttle; not JWT (the patient has no account).

Patient action link: lists free reschedule times for the link's own appointment (RESCHEDULE-purpose links only; branch/service/doctor fixed by the appointment, horizon capped at PUBLIC_AVAILABILITY_HORIZON_DAYS). Authorised by the 256-bit random single-use link token (only its sha256 digest is stored; PatientActionLinkService.resolve — expires at min(7d, appointment start), consumed on use); every unknown/expired/consumed token is the same uniform 404. Read-only, free times only. Per-IP @Throttle; not JWT (the patient has no account).

Patient action link: moves the link's own appointment to a new time (RESCHEDULE-purpose links only). Authorised by the 256-bit random single-use link token (only its sha256 digest is stored; PatientActionLinkService.resolve — expires at min(7d, appointment start), consumed on use); every unknown/expired/consumed token is the same uniform 404. Body is only a start time; the appointment is read from the link, never the caller, and AppointmentsService.reschedule re-validates the clinic window and slot at write time; the link is consumed afterwards. @SkipCsrf because the credential is the token in the URL, not a cookie. Per-IP @Throttle; not JWT (the patient has no account).

Patient action link: cancels the link's own appointment (CANCEL-purpose links only). Authorised by the 256-bit random single-use link token (only its sha256 digest is stored; PatientActionLinkService.resolve — expires at min(7d, appointment start), consumed on use); every unknown/expired/consumed token is the same uniform 404. Body is only an optional reason; window/terminal-state rules are re-checked at request time, no refund is ever initiated, and the link is consumed afterwards. @SkipCsrf because the credential is the token in the URL, not a cookie. Per-IP @Throttle; not JWT (the patient has no account).

Waitlist offer: shows the offered slot (clinic, branch, service, doctor, time, respond-by deadline, offer state — no patient identity). Authorised by the 256-bit random WAITLIST_OFFER link token (sha256-hashed at rest, PatientActionLinkService.resolve; purpose and offer binding re-checked); every invalid token is the same uniform 404. Read-only; a valid token on a no-longer-actionable offer returns 200 with its state. Per-IP @Throttle; not JWT (the waitlisted patient has no account).

Waitlist offer: accepts the offer and books the slot for the waitlisted customer. Authorised by the 256-bit random WAITLIST_OFFER link token (sha256-hashed at rest, PatientActionLinkService.resolve; purpose and offer binding re-checked); every invalid token is the same uniform 404. Takes no body; acceptance is gated by a single conditional UPDATE (PENDING and before responds_by) so only one of two racing accepts wins, then the ordinary AppointmentsService.create path (conflict prevention, bot actor) runs; a non-actionable offer is a 409. @SkipCsrf because the credential is the token in the URL. Per-IP @Throttle; not JWT (the waitlisted patient has no account).

Waitlist offer: declines the offer and returns the entry to the waitlist. Authorised by the 256-bit random WAITLIST_OFFER link token (sha256-hashed at rest, PatientActionLinkService.resolve; purpose and offer binding re-checked); every invalid token is the same uniform 404. Takes no body; a conditional UPDATE (PENDING only) makes it race-safe and a non-actionable offer is a 409. @SkipCsrf because the credential is the token in the URL. Per-IP @Throttle; not JWT (the waitlisted patient has no account).

Public booking: starts or resumes the visitor's booking session (mints the guest_token / booking_session_id cookies when absent) and returns the current selection. Authorised by the HttpOnly guest_token JWT cookie (minted server-side under the data-less guest-discovery tenant, no roles/permissions) plus the server-held booking selection; the caller supplies no tenant identity as an authorisation input and the clinic must pass the live ELIGIBLE_CLINIC predicate (APPROVED, active, public_booking_enabled). Only a conversation this same guest owns can be adopted; a foreign id is ignored. @SkipCsrf: no existing cookie credential is being exercised. Per-IP @Throttle; not JWT (the visitor has no account).

Public booking: creates the appointment for the anonymous visitor. Authorised by the HttpOnly guest_token JWT cookie (minted server-side under the data-less guest-discovery tenant, no roles/permissions) plus the server-held booking selection; the caller supplies no tenant identity as an authorisation input and the clinic must pass the live ELIGIBLE_CLINIC predicate (APPROVED, active, public_booking_enabled). Accepts NO resource ids (only name, phone, optional email/insurance/notes): clinic, branch, services, doctor and time come from the recorded selection, and AppointmentsService.create re-validates everything transactionally under the clinic's least-privilege bot actor in that clinic's own tenant context. Customer reuse requires phone AND name (F-19) so an existing patient's record is never overwritten. Tightest booking throttle (10/min). @SkipCsrf: the credential is the guest cookie, not a staff session. Per-IP @Throttle; not JWT (the visitor has no account).

Marketing unsubscribe: shows the clinic name, a MASKED address and whether it is already suppressed. Authorised by the stateless HMAC-SHA256 token over (tenantId, email) (UnsubscribeTokenService.verify — constant-time compare, so it cannot be forged or altered); every invalid token is the same uniform 404. Must work without signing in, permanently (FR-E006). Read-only; reveals nothing else about the recipient. Per-IP @Throttle; not JWT (the recipient has no account).

Marketing unsubscribe: suppresses that one address for that one clinic's marketing mail and clears the matching customer's marketing opt-in. Authorised by the stateless HMAC-SHA256 token over (tenantId, email) (UnsubscribeTokenService.verify — constant-time compare, so it cannot be forged or altered); every invalid token is the same uniform 404. Must work without signing in, permanently (FR-E006). Idempotent; takes no body and can affect only the (tenant, address) pair the token encodes. @SkipCsrf because the credential is the token in the URL. Per-IP @Throttle; not JWT (the recipient has no account).
